evidence.note: Trains a neural network to estimate a mixed-integer-optimization solver's true optimality gap from its internal state, then applies conformal prediction calibration to derive stopping thresholds with rigorous probabilistic guarantees, cutting solve times by over 60% while keeping solutions within 0.1% of optimal with 95% probability across six Distributional MIPLIB problem families.
evidence.title: Conformal Prediction for Early Stopping in Mixed Integer Optimization
